versions.subject: suspicious csi.exe (rcsi.exe)  LOLBAS detection rule
versions.detection:
basic:
    - Image|endswith: '\csi.exe'
    - Image|endswith: '\rcsi.exe'
renamed:    
    - OriginalFilename: 'csi.exe'
    - OriginalFilename: 'rcsi.exe'
selection:    
    Company: 'Microsoft Corporation'
condition: (basic or renamed) and selection
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\csi.exe", "*\\rcsi.exe") OR OriginalFilename IN ("csi.exe", "rcsi.exe") Company="Microsoft Corporation"
